issues: React dev-warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the codebase-wide instrumentation (x-file-name/x-line-number spans) is being injected inside <option> children of the crisis-digest-weekday/hour selects. This is a hydration warning, not a functional bug (selects still work end-to-end), and it originates from the auto-instrumentation, not from CrisisExtensions.jsx. Optional: render option labels as plain string children so instrumentation can't wrap them.

critical_code_review_comments: crisis_commander.run_weekly_director_digest (L2927-2950): when invoked with an explicit org_id, the weekday/hour gate AND the 6-day dedupe are bypassed — that is documented in the code comment, but the last_sent watermark is still stamped unconditionally. If ops run a manual/test digest, it will suppress the next scheduled hourly send for 6 days. Consider only stamping director_digest_last_sent when org_id is None (i.e., scheduled path).

crisis_commander.director_digest_preview (L3074-3078): the preview endpoint calls _build_director_digest even when crisis_settings.director_digest is False. That's fine for UX (operators want to preview before enabling), but consider gating on _require_operator alone (already done) and adding a small note in the response when the toggle is off so the UI can hint 'preview only — digest currently disabled'.

crisis_commander._org_sitrep_templates (L3031-3035): returns _DEFAULT_SITREP_TEMPLATES by reference when an org has no custom set. Since callers mutate the list (POST/DELETE build a new list before update_one, so it's safe today), but a future refactor that mutates in place would leak between orgs. Consider returning `list(_DEFAULT_SITREP_TEMPLATES)` unconditionally or freezing the default.

CrisisSettingsBody (L2727-2728): director_digest_weekday/hour are Optional so a partial POST does not clobber unrelated fields — good. Ensure the frontend crisis-digest-weekday/hour selects only POST the changed field (they currently POST just {director_digest_weekday}/{director_digest_hour} in patch() — verified via network).

CrisisExtensions.jsx crisis-digest-weekday/hour selects: consider disabling controls (or showing a helper hint) when crisis_settings.director_digest is off so users understand scheduling only matters once the toggle is enabled.
